mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a peripheral prophet who with his small group of supporters stands against the political and religious establishment in Jerusalem."
Jeremiah is a peripheral prophet who with his small group of supporters stands against the political and religious establishment in Jerusalem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a discussion of two parts of a subject arranged in an A B B A order."
A chiasm is a discussion of two parts of a subject arranged in an A B B A order.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered by most to be the founder of modern linguistics."
Saussure is considered by most to be the founder of modern linguistics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to identify some of these sources that were used in authoring the Pentateuch."
The Documentary Hypothesis is an attempt to identify some of these sources that were used in authoring the Pentateuch.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an Old Testament scholar who has read Genesis 12 and 1 Samuel 16-22 from a deconstructionist perspective."
Miscall is an Old Testament scholar who has read Genesis 12 and 1 Samuel 16-22 from a deconstructionist perspective.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a broad movement encompassing many disciplines."
Structuralism is a broad movement encompassing many disciplines.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a literary device by which a writer reveals the limits of his discussion of a particular subject."
Inclusion is a literary device by which a writer reveals the limits of his discussion of a particular subject.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theology framed to meet definite problems called forth by the exigencies of specific historical conditions."
The theology of the Bible is a theology framed to meet definite problems called forth by the exigencies of specific historical conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a board game where a knowledge of the rules is required for the game to be executed meaningfully."
An analogy is a board game where a knowledge of the rules is required for the game to be executed meaningfully.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the literary counterpart to redaction criticism at the micro level, for the Evangelist uses the same techniques of selection, omission and structure in both."
Intertextuality at the macro level is the literary counterpart to redaction criticism at the micro level, for the Evangelist uses the same techniques of selection, omission and structure in both.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a judicious use of all the hermeneutical tools along with cross-pollination between the studies."
The only solution is a judicious use of all the hermeneutical tools along with cross-pollination between the studies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of literary criticism that investigates the origins of ancient text in order to understand "the world behind the text"; it is also known as the historical-critical method or higher criticism."

Historical criticism is a branch of literary criticism that investigates the origins of ancient text in order to understand "the world behind the text"; it is also known as the historical-critical method or higher criticism.
